# Tinkery / provisional board

Nothing confirmed. Unsaved.

## I think this is about… / guess

You want a human-first board and meta harness that compounds both itself and the codebase: coordinating the entire agentic software development lifecycle with rigor, durability, cohesion, and verification, so you can taste the final product as restaurateur and see a PR ready for human review that makes the next change easier.

Supporting words:

> system that compounds itself and serves as a meta harness (original 1)

> human first board for coordinainting work from the entire continuum of agentic software development lifecycle (original 1)

> it should operate like a michellin star resteraunt and I am the resterauntaur that tastes the final delicious product. (original 1)

> a PR that is ready to be reviewed by human that considers the health of the code base and makes the next change easier. (original 1)

> both (original 2)

## Desired experience / proposed

You experience the brain dump, prompt, hunch, or intuition becoming a cohesive result across the agentic software development lifecycle, ending in a PR ready for human review that considers codebase health and makes the next change easier; you remain the restaurateur who tastes the final delicious product.

## Doesn't fit yet

None identified by the agent; this does not mean everything fits.

## One question in focus

Besides tasting the final product, where should you intervene or approve work before the PR is ready for human review?

## Possible approaches / not accepted

## Settled questions / answered, not confirmation

Should “compounds itself” primarily mean the meta harness improves, the codebase becomes easier to change, or both? 
Answer / original 2: both

I have been trying so hard to work on a system that compounds itself and serves as a meta harness. its a human first board for coordinainting work from the entire continuum of agentic software development lifecycle that has the rigor and durability and cohesive and verification that all 'just work's and thinks about the future of any code base it works on. not just the trees, but the forest. it should operate like a michellin star resteraunt and I am the resterauntaur that tastes the final delicious product. it goes from this part (the brain dump-the prompt-the hunch-the intuition) all the way to a PR that is ready to be reviewed by human that considers the health of the code base and makes the next change easier. that is my true goal.
